title: Pollen balances got clearer rules
summary:
Pollen accounting became more explicit while model routes, image workers, and the interfaces around them got steadier.

Tier balances moved out of Polar and gained daily refills at 00:00 UTC, with no rollover. Requests draw from tier Pollen first, then crypto, then packs. Later changes marked seven models as paid-only, so daily tier grants cannot cover those requests; the model API, Play, and Enter now identify them. Enter also gained a tier-balance breakdown.

The `kimi` route moved to Kimi K2.5, adding image input and a 256,000-token context window. `nova-fast` and Claude 3.5 Haiku moved to native Bedrock configuration, with Nova Lite as a fallback for `nova-fast`. API-key tracking stopped adding synchronous database writes to authentication requests, and failed Claude or Gemini image fetches now return actionable client errors instead of generic 500s.

Flux, Z-Image, and Sana workers gained configurable registration addresses, reducing dependence on particular endpoints. `klein-large` concurrency was adjusted to avoid GPU memory errors while preserving capacity. Supporter logos switched to Z-Image, and the `turbo` image route was removed; self-hosted routing retains zimage and Flux pools.

A “What’s new” banner on Enter’s home and sign-in pages now reads recent highlights instead of relying on a disabled hard-coded banner. Purchase options and balance explanations gained clearer labels and examples, while API-key delete controls remain visible when the table scrolls.
